name: What steps are involved in the restoration remodeling process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the restoration remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an on-site evaluation to inspect visible damage and identify underlying issues in wall framing or subfloors. Once a detailed scope and plan are established, crew members remove damaged drywall, trim, and ruined flooring. Next, framing repairs and rough-in work by licensed plumbing and electrical trades take place. Once inspections pass, the finish phase begins: crews install and tape new drywall, lay tile or marble, build custom trim and molding, and apply interior paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes damage assessment, demolition, structural and framing repairs, rough-in mechanicals, drywall installation, custom finish carpentry, tile, and final painting.
